notes: GeoTalk 1.3: a fix aimed squarely at the app closing when an internet call starts. The call engine now connects FIRST and attaches your voice only after the connection is up — until then nothing touches the phone's audio hardware, which is where calls were dying on some phones. Calls also now use the proper telephony audio mode with audio focus, like the stock dialer. And if a call ever does close the app again, the safety guard now recognises it from the session trail and sends the next call straight to Push-to-Talk instead of repeating the same failure. Everything from 1.2 is kept: the update popup no longer appears after you have already updated, incoming calls ring with your default ringtone and vibration, problem reports always record the newest incident, near-instant call setup, direct phone-to-phone WebRTC voice first, Cloudflare TURN relay (UDP, TCP and TLS 443) when a network blocks the direct path, Push-to-Talk as the final fallback, plus internet and Bluetooth chat + voice calls, voice messages and in-app updates.
